statement: The nine-dimensional moral structure is stable across 109,294 passages, 11 languages and 3,000 years -- not an artifact of the formalism.

evidence.note: NO test statistic, effect size, CI or null model is reported anywhere; the summary table reads 'Confirmed'. The companion paper concedes the confound: results are measured THROUGH a multilingual embedding model whose language-agnostic representation may itself carry the apparent universality -- 'until that confound is excluded, the axes are invariant retains a deflationary reading'.

history.event: entered exploratory: retrospective, model-mediated, and the instrument confound is conceded but not excluded
